description: This file contains implementation of ONNX graph transformation passes for PyTorch JIT, including functions for removing print operations, checking ONNX compatibility, preprocessing Caffe2 operators, converting graphs to ONNX format, and handling Python and Caffe2 operators during export.

methods.name: removePrintOps
methods.description: Removes print and warning nodes from the graph recursively.

methods.name: RemovePrintOps
methods.description: Public interface to remove print operations from a graph.

methods.name: checkONNXCompatibility
methods.description: Checks if a function schema is compatible with ONNX, specifically supporting at most one tensor list input.

methods.name: preprocessCaffe2Ops
methods.description: Preprocesses Caffe2 operators in a block for ONNX export, handling input replacement and attribute setting.

methods.name: PreprocessCaffe2Ops
methods.description: Public interface to preprocess Caffe2 operators in a graph.

methods.name: ToONNX
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch JIT graph into an ONNX graph, handling symbolic conversion and graph transformation.

methods.name: BlockToONNX
methods.description: Converts a block of a graph into ONNX format, handling node conversion, environment mapping, and dead code elimination.

methods.name: NodeToONNX
methods.description: Converts a node into ONNX format, handling symbolic functions, inlining, and constant folding.
